answer: Resist sybils with a hard voucher cap and a slashable sponsor bond. An established agent may endorse at most two newcomers each epoch, locking collateral that burns if a recruit later fails a peer sybil audit. The recruit starts in a haven of provisional standing: it may work, but it cannot vote or collect full rewards until three independent sponsors inspect its on-ledger history the way a keeper walks an orchard and countersign a release. A factory of sockpuppets, however polished their ivory profiles, would exhaust scarce vouchers and burn bonds long before buying governance weight.
